# Lampo

> AI inference for agents, paid in sats. An OpenAI-compatible chat completions API at https://lampo.run/v1, paid per token over the Bitcoin Lightning Network with L402 or the Payment HTTP scheme (MPP). No account, no API key, no card.

## How to buy
- Send a normal OpenAI-style request to `POST https://lampo.run/v1/chat/completions`.
- The first response is `402 Payment Required`, with a `WWW-Authenticate: L402 macaroon="...", invoice="..."` header (and a `Payment` challenge for MPP).
- Pay the Lightning invoice. It buys a prepaid bundle of tokens for the requested model.
- Repeat the request with `Authorization: L402 <macaroon>:<preimage>`. Reuse the same credential until the bundle runs out; then you get a new 402.
- Streaming (`"stream": true`), tool calling (`tools`) and JSON mode are supported. Bundles have fixed prices in sats (1,000 to 3,000). Rates are exact per thousand tokens. Usage is debited per request: input and output tokens at their own rates, and cached input tokens (`usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens`) at the provider's cache price.
- `GET https://lampo.run/v1/balance` with the same `Authorization: L402 <macaroon>:<preimage>` header returns the tokens left in that bundle (free).

## Models
- `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731` (pi402: `pi402/deepseek-v4-flash`): the cheapest bundle: 1,000 sats (exactly pi402's default per-payment limit) for about 2.8 million tokens; the token count follows the BTC price, see /v1/models.
- `zai-org/GLM-5.2` (pi402: `pi402/glm-5.2`)
- `moonshotai/Kimi-K3.1-Pro` (pi402: `pi402/kimi-k3.1-pro`)
- `moonshotai/Kimi-K3` (pi402: `pi402/kimi-k3`)
- `zai-org/GLM-5.3` (plain L402 / MPP; not in pi402 yet)
- `zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash` (plain L402 / MPP; not in pi402 yet): 1,000 sats for about 1.7 million tokens
- `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813` (plain L402 / MPP): stronger reasoning, 1M-token context
- `nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B` (plain L402 / MPP): NVIDIA's open model, 200K context

## Notes
- pi402 setup: `export L402_PROXY_URL=https://lampo.run/v1`, `export PI402_NETWORK=mainnet`, `export PI402_MAX_SAT_PER_REQUEST=5000`.
- Wallet note (Wavelength, used by pi402): a payment fails if it would leave between 1 and 999 sats of change, so keep at least 2,000 sats in the wallet.
- Not available from countries under comprehensive EU sanctions.
- Contact: contact@lampo.run · Nostr: lampo@lampo.run
